semiconductor_relevance: High — Epihouse Optoelectronics is a key supplier of epitaxial wafers, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing for various applications.
summary: Epihouse Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. specializes in producing high-quality epitaxial wafers for optical communication, data centers, industrial sensing, and custom applications. Their products support advanced technologies such as 3D face recognition, 5G base stations, and unmanned LiDAR systems, catering to the growing demand for sophisticated semiconductor solutions.
